signIn.footnote: Use the account you sign in to the dashboard with. Accounts are created by an administrator.

errors.credentials: That email and password do not match an account.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.offline: {server} could not be reached. Check the address and the connection.
errors.notCapuchoo: {server} answered, but it is not a Capuchoo server. Check the address.
errors.unreachable: {server} did not answer. A server that was asleep can take a minute to wake: try again.

server.title: Connect to your server
server.body: Capuchoo runs on your team’s own server. Enter the address your admin gave you.
server.label: Server address
server.hint: The same address the dashboard opens at, without a path.

live.live: Live: changes arrive as they happen

purpose.viewer: You can see this app's builds and the devices running them.
purpose.tester: You can install any of this app's builds on this phone.
purpose.developer: You can install builds and deliver them to dev and staging.
purpose.admin: You can install builds and deliver them to every channel.

ahead.headline: Ahead of {channel}
ahead.detail: This phone runs {installed}, newer than the {target} {channel} serves.

untracked.headline: {installed} installed
untracked.detail: {channel} serves no build yet, so there is nothing to compare it with.

channel.bundleHint: Devices run the web layer of the native build.

install.failed: Android could not install the update.

permission.missing: This app is not allowed to install apps yet.
permission.title: Allow installs
permission.text: Android asks once: allow Capuchoo to install apps, then come back and try again.

integrity.package: The file is {pkg}, which is not one of {app}'s identifiers. It was not installed.
integrity.version: The file is build {got}, not build {want}. It was not installed.
integrity.certificate: The file is signed with a different certificate than the server recorded. It was not installed.

conflict.title: Replace the installed app?
conflict.downgrade: This phone has {installed}, newer than {target}, and Android will not install an older build over it.
conflict.certificate: The installed app is signed with a different key, so Android will not update it.
conflict.dataLoss: Uninstalling it first deletes its data on this phone.
conflict.kept: The installed app was kept, so nothing changed.

deliver.title: Deliver to {channel}?
deliver.prodWarning: {channel} serves field devices. They will be offered {version} the next time they check.
deliver.sheetText: Pick the build this channel should serve. Nothing is rebuilt.
deliver.none: No build of this channel's flavour has been published.
deliver.pauseText: Devices on it stop being offered updates until it is resumed.

activity.heading: Activity
activity.emptyText: New builds, deliveries and pauses on your apps appear here as they happen.
activity.notifyText: While Capuchoo runs, new builds and deliveries arrive as notifications.

profile.title: You
profile.notificationsHint: Notifications arrive while Capuchoo is running. The Activity tab always has everything.
profile.signOutText: Your session ends on the server, and what this phone kept for it is deleted.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.modeHint: Following the system switches with Android's dark theme and its schedule.

colors.title: Colours
colors.customHint: Pick any colour; Material builds the whole palette from it.
colors.rolesHint: Every colour in the app is one of these roles, generated from the colour and the style above.

brand.name: Capuchoo
brand.hint: Your colour exactly, on Capuchoo's quiet paper surfaces.

fidelity.name: Fidelity
fidelity.hint: Your colour exactly, carried into every surface.

tonalSpot.name: Tonal spot
tonalSpot.hint: Android's default: calm, softened tones of your colour.

expressive.name: Expressive
expressive.hint: Shifted hues for a bolder, playful palette.

vibrant.name: Vibrant
vibrant.hint: The most saturated version of your colour.

monochrome.name: Monochrome
monochrome.hint: Greys only; the environments keep their colours.

lanes.title: Every release, where it stands
lanes.body: Dev, staging and prod side by side, with the build each one serves right now.

install.title: Any build, one tap away
install.body: See what this phone runs against its channel and install the build it should have.

notify.title: Know the moment it ships
notify.body: New builds, deliveries and pauses arrive as they happen, for the apps you choose.

roles.title: Made for the whole team
roles.body: Testers install, developers deliver to dev and staging, admins run every channel.

choose.title: Pick an app
choose.subtitle: Everything after this is about the app you pick. Switch any time from the top bar.
choose.emptyText: Apps you are given a role on appear here. Ask an admin to add you to one.

home.noTelemetryText: Devices report checks and installs once a build with the Capuchoo updater runs on them.

channels.title: Channels
channels.emptyText: Channels are created from the dashboard or the Capuchoo CLI.
channels.goneText: It was removed, or this account no longer reaches it.

builds.title: Builds
builds.noNativeText: Builds published with the Capuchoo CLI appear here.
builds.noOtaText: Web bundles published over the air appear here.

devices.title: Devices
devices.search: Search by model, name or id
devices.truncated: Showing the {shown} most recently seen of {total}.
devices.emptyText: A device appears once a build with the Capuchoo updater checks for an update.

device.removeText: Its history is deleted. It registers again the next time it checks for an update.
device.goneText: It was removed, or it has not reported in a long time.
device.assignText: {device} gets its updates from the channel picked here, whatever it was built for.
device.assignHint: Without an override, the device follows the channel its build asks for.

preview.rowText: See the app as a tester or a viewer sees it, without changing your role.
preview.title: View as
preview.text: Every screen narrows to what this role gets. Your real role is untouched, and the server keeps deciding on it.
preview.footnote: A preview only lowers what this phone offers; it cannot grant anything.

people.title: People
people.failed: The team could not be fetched
people.adminOnlyText: Roles on an app are given by its admins.
people.selfHint: Your own role is changed from the dashboard, so nobody locks themselves out from a phone.
people.pendingHint: Once they join, they appear above without a role: give them one there.
people.noAccountText: {email} has no Capuchoo account. Create an invite link to {org}: once they join with it, give them their role from People.
people.linkText: Send it to {email}. When they have joined, give them the {role} role from People.
people.shareText: You are invited to work on {app} with Capuchoo.
people.removeText: They lose access to {app}. Their account and other apps are untouched.
